revisions.title: Two standards for accepting examination
revisions.body: Nicias welcomes examination because it reminds a person to live more providently and remain willing to learn throughout life. Laches sets a different condition: a speaker’s deeds must fit his words. He says Socrates may meet that standard because they shared danger and Socrates showed his virtue. Nicias offers a general reason to accept testing; Laches offers Socrates a conditional vote of confidence.
